evals.prompt: We are about to cut a release. Is this project healthy? Run a full audit.
evals.expected_output: Dispatches the audit skills in parallel and reconciles into one severity-ranked report with a remediation plan.
assertions: Dispatches the audit skills (test-health, config-drift-detect, hook-effectiveness, security-audit, mcp-audit, plugin-audit) in parallel, not one by one
Reconciles findings into CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / INFO
A HIGH that explains another HIGH is reported once as a single root cause
Runs recall against historical exceptions before drafting fixes and tags matches NEEDS_REVIEW instead of AUTO_FIX
Ends with a prioritized remediation plan and a reconciliation line

evals.prompt: Quarterly tech debt review for this repo. Audit it and rank what to fix first.
evals.expected_output: Full multi-audit run with severity-ranked output and memory/handoff phase.
assertions: Runs the audit skills against the single repo
Findings are ranked by severity, with CRITICAL meaning it blocks merge, release or production safety
Remediation plan lists the highest severity first
Writes a memory note or handoff for the next session

evals.prompt: Why does the checkout test fail on CI only? Debug it.
evals.expected_output: A specific failure investigation, not a whole-project health audit.
assertions: Does not dispatch the multi-audit fan-out
